rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, bold weights (600/700). Use for all section titles and card headers.
rules.body: Medium weight (500) for better readability on dark backgrounds. Relaxed leading.
rules.accent: Use 'Teko' or 'Bebas Neue' style sizing (very large) for numbers and stats.

usage.primary: CTAs, Active States, Winning Numbers, 'Join' Buttons
usage.background: Global page background. NEVER use pure black #000000, use #09090B.

effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-filter: blur(12px); background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
effects.scanlines: background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.06), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.02), rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.06)); background-size: 100% 2px, 3px 100%;

landing_page.description: Asymmetric, high-impact visual blocks. Hero section must dominate.

dashboard.description: Dense, data-heavy, minimal scrolling. Sidebar navigation.

mobile.description: Vertical scroll, bottom navigation bar for app-like feel.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-yellow-400 transition-all skew-x-[-10deg]

cards.tournament: relative overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-card hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors group

inputs.default: bg-secondary/50 border-white/10 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-none

hero_background.usage: Landing page hero background, overlay with dark gradient

battle_royale.usage: Card background for Battle Royale mode

clash_squad.usage: Card background for Clash Squad mode

gamer.usage: User profile default, landing page social proof

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Import the fonts in index.css immediately.
2. THEME: Force DARK MODE. Do not implement a light mode toggle. The brand is strictly dark.
3. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the dashboard. Avoid simple list views.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners (set radius to 0 or 2px).
5. MOTION: Add 'framer-motion' for page transitions and hover effects. Cards should scale slightly (1.02) on hover.
6. DATA: Use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
7. NAV: Implement a Bottom Navigation Bar for mobile views (Home, Matches, Wallet, Profile).
8. GLASS: Use the glassmorphism effect for the Navbar and sticky headers.

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside containers. Don't let text touch borders.
universal_guidelines.contrast: Ensure all text is legible. Use 'text-zinc-400' for secondary text, 'text-white' for primary.
universal_guidelines.interaction: All buttons must have a hover state (brightness-110 or translate-y-[-2px]).
universal_guidelines.empty_states: Never leave a section empty. Use a placeholder icon and text (e.g., 'No upcoming matches').
